newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ANALYSTS COMMENTS ON HOOGOVENS H1 RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: ANALYSTS COMMENTS ON HOOGOVENS H1 RESULTS.

text.p: Dutch steel and aluminium maker Hoogovens NV on Wednesday reported first half 1997 net profit of 194 million guilders versus 139 million guilders in the same period last year. Analysts had expected a first half net profit from ordinary operations of between 162-205 million guilders. Hoogovens also said it expected net profits for the full year 1997 to show a strong increase.
Following are a selection of analysts' comments:
"The results are more or less in line with estimates, I'm quite pleased.

"There is an extraordinary gain of 13 million guilders so that brings the profit to around 180 million, just about what I was looking for. The forecast for a strong rise in full-year profit is not surprising. I had the company set for for a strong improvement in the second half."

"We had thought the result would be more positive than it was, the quality does not look so good but it's a bit early to tell. The extraordinaries showed a gain of 13 million guilders -- that was unexpected and we'll want to know what happened there."
